newsitem.title: UK: Japanese stocks in London rise on back of Dow.
newsitem.headline: Japanese stocks in London rise on back of Dow.

text.p: Japanese stocks in London rose slightly in quiet trading on Thursday on the back of a firm Dow, after the release of U.S. economic data showing inflation was still tamed.
"New York pushed it up later in the day with blue chips firming," said one trader. "Overall it has been a quiet day."
The trader mentioned Electrical equipment maker Sony Corp and Computer giant Fujitsu Ltd as representative of the day's trading.
Sony was trading at 11,560 yen in London, up 60 yen from the closing price in Tokyo. Fujitsu was unchanged at 1,700 yen.
The Nikkei/ISE 50 index gained 4.33 points or 0.26 percent to 1,673.73.
U.S. July consumer price index, excluding food and energy, rose an expected 0.2 percent.
